description: Draft a new Google business description (up to 750 characters; 250+ reads best). Google suspends listings over this field, so the draft is refused if it contains a link, phone number, email, prices or offers, HTML, all-caps shouting, or repeated keywords. Write it about what the business actually does, from my_google_profile. Creates a DRAFT only — nothing on Google changes. Show the owner the draft this returns, word for word, and publish it with publish_change only after they say yes.
name: propose_description
title: Draft a new business description
